Introduction
This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every six months 
as indicated by M6 in the title block
The 
technical specification of the pump
Q = 1000 
M3/H H = 100 M 
P = 400 K.W. V = 6000 V
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Hatem Abd El Daim and tested by eng. Hanay Fahmy 
Madany at 13-7-2004 High Dam hydraulic PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Stop pump and switch off the power supply
Close the out let and inlet valves
Put suitable warning boards
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet and safety shoes
Set of wrench
Alignment equipment
Grease for lubricating
